Per-dish share receipts

A review with several dishes shares one dish at a time: its own one-line receipt on its own photo. Phones are at real iPhone size (402 pt). Example entry: four dishes at Small Wins, the sandwich with two photos, the flat white with none.

A. Dish names above the cards (recommended)

Tap a dish name to switch. The cards still swipe between sticker, story and post, exactly as now. Single-dish reviews look the same as today, with no names row.

B. Swipe between dishes

Sticker, Story and Post become a switch at the top; swiping moves to the next dish. Changes the swipe you already approved, so I'd go with A.

Rules in both

  • Each dish's receipt is the same receipt with only that dish's line: place, suburb, signature, wordmark.
  • A dish with several photos shows each one as a dot; the first is picked to start.
  • A photo showing two dishes can be used for both.
  • The receipt starts small at bottom left and can be dragged, per card, as now. No auto-placement.
  • Share sends the card in front only.
  • The whole receipt stays as a sticker, never on a photo.
